name: Rosy
source:
An apathetic angel who resides in room 103. She's more interested in looking at her phone rather than following the angel's teachings.

[spoiler]Her real name is Kanon Nonomiya. She was forced to join the 'family' after [url=https://vndb.org/c101159]Mother[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c83874]Sally[/url] physically abused and drugged her to the point where she could no longer resist.
